data.narrative:
Manifold Bio is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Gleb Kuznetsov and Pierce Ogden that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 public-market biotech peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-sector participants including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using $40M in total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression to the next funding stage yields an implied valuation of $80M. Peer-Median analysis was not viable—while 7 biotech peers exist in the dataset, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies yielded fewer than the three datapoints required for statistical reliability. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Manifold Bio's revenue is not on file, precluding use of the Biotech & Health sector P/S median of 8.1x observed across the three public comparables.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, with a central estimate of $80M. The narrow methodological foundation—relying solely on stage-progression mechanics—represents the primary uncertainty. Resolution would require either access to Manifold Bio's revenue or identification of additional early-stage private biotech peers with disclosed valuations at comparable funding levels.
